eps.t: These Doors Are Made for Knockin' / The Raft
eps.d: When the Dino Babies are trapped inside a cave by a saber-toothed wolf, Truman tells them a story of three Dino Babies who each thought the doors to their caves were the best.

eps.t: Dak and the Beanstalk / When Dinos Soar
eps.d: Dak strands the Dino Babies on an island, so they make rafts to get back across the water. Only Stanley's raft works.

eps.t: Goldisocks and the Three Dinobabies / Tree's a Crowd
eps.d: Truman has difficulty telling a story about a beanstalk, five adventurers captured by a giant and their escape. With support from the others, he finishes it.

eps.t: The Wizard of Ahhs / Some Like It Hot
eps.d: The Dino Babies try to make Franklin fly to help him overcome his fear of heights. He finds out how to fly but Dak gets him to use it against his friends.

eps.t: A Big Little Problem / Snoring Beauty
eps.d: LaBrea tells Marshall a story of Goldisocks who barges into the house of Three Dino Babies, while Truman, Stanley and Franklin are elsewhere.

eps.t: The Cloneheads / Robbing Hood
eps.d: Dak finds the Dino Babies' tree cave which annoys the others especially when he pretends to have an injury.

eps.t: Fuzzy Come Home / Crumby Trails to You
eps.d: Truman tells a story of a Dino baby girl called Dorothy and her adventures in the land of Ahh.

eps.t: A Tooth Fairy Tale / The Egg and Them
eps.d: Truman tells a scary monster story, then the Dino Babies are met by a dragon baby named Puffy. They are against him at first but befriend him after finding him.

eps.t: Look Before You Eek / Treasure Chest Island
eps.d: Marshall stumbles into a land inhabited by little Punysaurs and, along with hearing a story of a little red hen, he becomes their ruler until the smallest of them makes the Punysaurs come to their senses.

eps.t: Franklinstein / Washed Up
eps.d: Marshall has trouble sleeping, so Truman tells him a story of a Princess put under a sleeping spell.

eps.t: The Soreheads and the Stone / LaBrea's Secret Garden
eps.d: A group of alien heads mimic the Dino Babies' features and want Truman for his stories, but nobody believes Truman when he tells them. Moral Lesson: Sometimes things aren't what they appear to be.

eps.t: A Lad in a Lamp / Jurassic Ark
eps.d: In the middle of a bowling game, Truman tells a story about a hero named "Robbing Hood" who forms a band of Merry Men. Together they take back what the Sheriff of Rottingham taxed from the poor.

eps.t: Alice in Wonderfulland / The Abominable Snowbaby
eps.d: In the care of the Dino Babies, Fuzzy runs away. Stanley tries a substitute for Fuzzy, but Puffy helps find the real Fuzzy.

eps.t: Dakula / The Ugly Duckbill
eps.d: While on a camp out, Truman tells the story of a pizza eating vampire.

eps.t: The Different Dragon / Cyranose
eps.d: Truman tells a story of how people are special no matter what they look like.

eps.t: Peter Prank / Scarebusters
eps.d: After meeting their old friend Trixie, Truman tells the story of a dragon who was expected to scary because of who he was.

eps.t: A Nose for the Truth / Housepests
eps.d: Truman tells a story about how a man was ashamed of his appearance, but had a good heart to make up for it.

eps.t: Chrysanthemumbelina / Tantrum of the Opera
eps.d: Truman tells a story of a boy who never wanted to go to school. Moral Lesson: Education is as equally important as having fun.

eps.t: Rapermzel / The Braggy Little Tailor
eps.d: Franklin, trying to be brave, meets the Glowworms. Franklin's glowing makeover scares the Dino Babies, but he then introduces them to his new friends.

eps.t: The Selfish Ogre / Big Blanket Bedtime Story
eps.d: Truman tells the story of Pinosio, the boy whose nose always grew when he told a lie.

eps.t: The Frog Bride / Mr. Dakyll and Dr. Hide
eps.d: Various animals keep getting into the tree cave, causing the Dino Babies no end of problems.

eps.t: Goldfingers / The Starling and the Statue
eps.d: LaBrea has a dream about a Dino girl who lives in a flower, and tells the other Dino Babies.

eps.t: The Princess and the Pauper / The Dancing Princesses
eps.d: Truman tells the story of a Phantom living underneath an opera house, who repeatedly tries to kidnap the star singer, Christine, because he hates opera. Coincidentally, he isn't the only one.

eps.t: Oliver Twirp / The Snide Piper
eps.d: When LaBrea's mother gives her a bad haircut, she doesn't want the others to see. So Truman tells the story of a Princess whose hair grew to great lengths.

eps.t: Beauty and the Beak / Ebegeezer Scrimp
eps.d: The other Dino Babies are tired of Stanley's bragging, so Truman tells the story of a tailor who thought he was the best at everything and got himself in big trouble.

eps.t: The Emperor's New Robe / Mother Goose on the Loose
eps.d: When LaBrea refuses to share her flowers with the others, Truman tells a story of an ogre who was extremely selfish.
